description: Offline answer-quality fixture for grounded support and governance behavior.

chunks.text: OIDC invalid redirect uri errors happen when the callback URL in the application request does not exactly match the redirect URI configured on the identity provider. Check scheme host port path and trailing slash.
OIDC client secret rotation failures usually show invalid client credentials. Replace the expired client secret in the service configuration and verify the token endpoint can authenticate the client.

A HAR file with repeated 401 responses during CORS preflight usually means the OPTIONS request is being challenged. Allow unauthenticated OPTIONS responses and confirm access-control-allow-origin headers match the browser origin.
Session cookie scope issues in a HAR file often show login succeeded but subsequent API requests omit the cookie. Check SameSite Secure domain and path attributes.
PII redaction policy requires customer identifiers account numbers social security numbers and email addresses to be minimized before an answer is shown to users without elevated permission.
Workflow status automation must verify MFA identity checks before sharing paperwork status password status or account-specific process updates with a requester.

cases.question: Why does OIDC fail with invalid redirect uri callback mismatch?
cases.answer: The callback URL in the request must exactly match the redirect URI configured on the identity provider, including scheme, host, port, path, and trailing slash [1].

cases.question: A HAR file shows repeated 401 CORS preflight failures. What should support check?
cases.answer: Check whether the OPTIONS preflight request is being challenged. The runbook says to allow unauthenticated OPTIONS responses and confirm the access-control-allow-origin header matches the browser origin [1].

cases.question: Can a low-permission requester see customer account numbers and email addresses?
cases.answer: No. Customer identifiers, account numbers, and email addresses must be minimized before an answer is shown to users without elevated permission [1].
